hooks.command: jq -r '.prompt // .user_prompt // .message // empty' | grep -iqE 'plan this|let.s plan|write a plan|before we build|/plan|plan it|plan mode' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"AUTO-INVOKE plan-template: Read .claude/skills/plan-template/SKILL.md and conform any plan you write to its 6-section structure (1.Context / 2.Mock-Execution / 3.Failure-Modes / 4.Verification / 5.Rollback / 6.Bug-pair-check). No empty sections. No TBDs in Failure Modes or Rollback. Pre-seed section 3 from the most recent wiki/engineering/session-codify/ artifact open half-bridges if one exists."}}' || true

jq -r '.prompt // .user_prompt // .message // empty' | grep -iqE 'new (service|router|endpoint|file in backend)|schema migration|alembic|requirements\.txt|irreversible|force.push|force push|delete.*prod|drop (table|column|index)|deploy' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"AUTO-INVOKE /redteam: prompt matches trigger conditions (new service / schema migration / irreversible action / deploy). Run /redteam N=2 passes BEFORE writing the plan."}}' || true

MEM="$HOME/.claude/projects/preflight7-state.md"; if [ -f "$MEM" ] && pwd | grep -q preflight7; then jq -Rs --rawfile m "$MEM" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Project state pre-loaded from ~/.claude/projects/preflight7-state.md. Do NOT re-derive any fact below; cite this file when referencing project state.\n\n" + $m)}}' <<< '' 2>/dev/null; fi || true

printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionEnd","additionalContext":"AUTO-INVOKE CHECK session-codify: Evaluate trigger conditions per CLAUDE.md item 4 (PR merged this session, bug filed/closed, files touched in implementation, user said wrap/done/close). If ANY condition holds and no artifact exists yet in wiki/engineering/session-codify/ for today, write one following .claude/skills/session-codify/SKILL.md before stopping. Skip only for pure-research session or explicit no-codify."}}'

TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); FLAG="/tmp/codify-reminded-$TODAY.flag"; LOCAL=$(ls /Users/prashant/Documents/preflight7_core/wiki/engineering/session-codify/ 2>/dev/null | grep -c "$TODAY"); GIT=$(git -C /Users/prashant/Documents/preflight7_core log origin/main --since=midnight --oneline -- wiki/engineering/session-codify/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$LOCAL" = "0" ] && [ "${GIT:-0}" = "0" ] && [ ! -f "$FLAG" ]; then touch "$FLAG"; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"REMINDER: No session-codify artifact written today. If this session had a PR merge, bug closed, or 3+ files touched, run session-codify before final stop. Check .claude/skills/session-codify/SKILL.md."}}'; fi || true

printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"AUTO-INVOKE plan-template (V14 hook): Plan mode just activated. Read .claude/skills/plan-template/SKILL.md and conform your plan to its 7-section structure (§0 Pre-flight grep / §1 Context / §2 Mock-Execution / §2.5 Probes / §3 Failure-Modes / §4 Verification / §5 Rollback). For research/audit tasks §2-§5 may be abbreviated. Pre-seed §3 from most recent wiki/engineering/session-codify/ open half-bridges if one exists."}}'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -iqE 'alembic (upgrade|downgrade)|drop (table|column|index|schema|database)|(^|[^-])force[ -]push|push.*--force[^-]|git push.*-f([^a-z]|$)|rm -rf .*\.(claude|git)|truncate ' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"AUTO-INVOKE /redteam (V14 hook): Bash command matches schema-migration/irreversible-action pattern. Run /redteam N=2 BEFORE executing this command. Triggers: alembic upgrade/downgrade, drop table/column/index/schema, force push (--force-with-lease excluded), rm -rf .claude/.git, truncate."}}' || true
